query:
SELECT 
  t.cardId, 
  t.`rank`,
  t.priceChange7d,
  c.id AS card_exists,
  c.name AS card_name
FROM trendingCardsCache t
LEFT JOIN cards c ON t.cardId = c.id
ORDER BY t.`rank`
